title: ITCH: NEW PLAYER DEFAULTS AND A DIFFICULTY ROW
why: His orders of 10-26: "when you put the new one to itch, make it so that it defaults to the easiest settings (except kid mode), so noobs can play it and not be overwhelmed", then "I want visible settings for all this stuff so that a itch player can make the game as difficult as the other/main game". On itch a profile with no saved choice starts on the new player set he confirmed: forgiving hits, the 15 minute raid, rich loot, light shake, the large crosshair, and seven extras off (elite affixes, waves grow, overseer phases, overseer rampage, bounty pillager bot, orbital debris, suppression). Only the row defaults move, so every single row stays visible and changeable, and a new difficulty row at the top of THE RAID switches all twelve at once between new player and main game (custom when one row was changed by hand). His PC, the party copy and stable are not on itch, so they boot exactly as before.
now: On itch: the new player set, and the difficulty row puts the main game back in one click. Everywhere else: the main game, with the same row.
